content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer, and a medical-necessity appeal has already been filed and failed. Auth-failure denials are provider liability, so the balance cannot be billed to the patient, and resubmission would only trigger CO-18. No further payer action can progress this claim, so the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
